title: tool-calling: improve execution ergonomics for multi/parallel tool calls, deterministic result injection & retries
author: Marisol Vega
release_notes: Improves tool-calling ergonomics: deterministic injection order for parallel tool calls, configurable retry/backoff for failed tool executions, fixes streaming edge cases when tool results are injected mid-stream. No API surface breaking changes.
description: Motivation: Users have been running into nondeterministic ordering and missed tool-result injections when models execute multiple tools in parallel. Additionally intermittent tool failures caused the overall response stream to stall or drop partial outputs. This PR implements three coordinated changes: 1) deterministic ordering for tool-result injection when multiple tools return concurrently by assigning a stable ordering key derived from the model call graph and tool IDs, 2) a retry/backoff policy for transient tool invocations exposed at the API surface with sane defaults and opt-outs, and 3) streaming stability fixes so injected tool outputs are flushed to active response streams without reordering or duplication. The changes touch the runtime executor, OpenAI compatibility layer, SDK shims, and add unit/e2e tests and docs. Summary of changes and rationale are below.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice approach. Can we make sure ordering key is stable across retries? Otherwise we may reorder after a retry.
Marisol Vega: Good point. The coordinator attaches a monotonic call instance id plus stable tool id hash. Retries preserve the original instance id so ordering stays stable.
Leila Ahmed: Tests look comprehensive. One nit: add a unit test for tool timeouts mapping to our API retry logic.
Marisol Vega: Added tests and increased timeout on the flaky streaming integration. See tests/e2e/test_parallel_tool_calls.py commit.
Connor Liu: CI failed on first run due to the streaming timeout, reran and green. Approving once CI is stable.
changelog_entries: Tool calling: deterministic injection order for parallel tool execution
Tool calling: configurable retry policy for transient failures (default 2 retries)
Streaming: flush injected tool outputs immediately to active response streams
SDK: add tool_retry_policy option in Python openai_compat wrapper
migration_notes: No breaking API changes. Users who relied on nondeterministic tool result ordering should review behavior. To opt-out of retries set tool_retry_policy.retries=0 in the function_calling options. SDK consumers should update to the latest openai_compat wrapper to get the new param.
testing_notes: Added unit tests covering coordinator ordering and retry logic. Added e2e test that runs 3 parallel tools with artificial latency and failure injection to validate retries and streaming. CI adjustments increased streaming test timeout to reduce flakiness.
security_implications: Minimal. Retries are bounded and configurable; no escalation of privileges. No plaintext secrets logged. Security scan returned no findings.
notes_for_release: Include short blurb in release notes about improved stability for parallel tool calling and the new tool_retry_policy option in SDKs.
